transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for offering to help with the plant care. Let me lay out what we're working with: the owner is away July 1 through July 14, and we have three plants — a jade plant that needs strong direct light, an orchid that needs bright indirect light and humidity, and a Boston fern that needs shade and steady moisture. I have a sunny south-facing sunroom at my place, which should be great for the jade plant. Marco and Talia, you've both offered to keep plants at your homes — could you tell me a bit about the lighting and humidity conditions at your places? That way we can match each plant to the right environment for the full two weeks. Also, the orchid has specific watering dates — July 2, 6, 10, and 14 — so whoever takes it needs to be able to commit to that schedule.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Hi Lena! I actually have a humid bathroom with bright indirect light that would be a great fit for the orchid. But I do need to flag something — I'll be away from July 6 through July 8, so I wouldn't be able to handle the July 6 watering myself. If someone else could cover that one watering date, I'd be happy to take the orchid for the rest of the time.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Hi Lena and Marco! I can take the Boston fern — I have a shaded porch that should be perfect for it since it needs shade and steady moisture. I do need to mention something important though: my cat chews jade leaves, so the jade plant can't safely stay at my place. It sounds like Lena's sunny south-facing sunroom would be a great fit for the jade plant anyway! And Marco, your humid bathroom with bright indirect light sounds ideal for the orchid. I'd be happy to cover the July 6 watering for you since I'll be around — I can swing by your place that day to water the orchid if that works for everyone.
transcript.speaker: A3
